title: Square of an expectation
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $\rho$ be a probability density on $\bbr_2^n$, and let $f:\bbr_2^n\to\bbr$. The square of the expectation of $f$ under $\rho$ is at most the expectation of $f^2$ under $\rho$.
